title: eleocharis palustris subsp. minor
intro: Eleocharis palustris subsp. minor, commonly known as Spike-rush, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, helping to alleviate symptoms of respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Spike-rush include expectorant and anti-inflammatory actions, which can help to relieve congestion and soothe irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
